document: Arun submitted the invoice. He also attached a receipt.
Priya reviewed the lease agreement. She flagged the termination clause.
The tenants filed a complaint with the housing board. They cited unsafe wiring in the kitchen.
The landlord replaced the water heater last month. It failed again within two weeks.
Rohan signed the rental contract on Monday. He paid the security deposit the same day.
Meera filed the tax return before the deadline. She requested an extension for the audit anyway.
The committee approved the budget on Friday. It allocated extra funds for maintenance the following week.
Arjun called the plumber about the leak. He described the damage to the ceiling in detail.
Rohan lent his umbrella to Arun. He forgot to return it the next day.
Priya handed the report to Meera. She found three errors in the first section.
The buyer sent the contract to the seller. He asked for one more clause before signing.
Kavya drafted the notice to vacate. She emailed it to the tenant on the same day.
The board rejected the proposed amendment. They cited budget concerns in the written decision.
Sanjay inspected the apartment before move-in. He noted a crack in the bathroom tile.
Divya raised the issue with the building manager. She received no response after a week.
Arun filed the maintenance request on Tuesday. The building manager acknowledged it by email. He followed up again on Friday when nothing was fixed.
